class.description: VoronoiDiagram2DResourceInspector (`Section 3.2`) Concrete Inspector Plugin mounting a `Voronoi2DControl` (`Voronoi2DCanvas` + Lloyd relaxation, grid/Poisson seeding, `Polygon2DResource` clip boundary binding, and CSR dual graph telemetry) whenever a `VoronoiDiagram2DResource` is inspected in the Godot Editor. Part of IdeamGeometry (2D/3D polygons, Voronoi diagrams, SDF grids, and tensor fields).
